We are woman-owned and operated. Our nurse practitioners and master injectors put natural results first with each treatment they deliver. Learn more about our team to discover what makes Boston Medical Aesthetics Boston’s best medspa experience. Jennifer Canesi Certified Adult Nurse Practitioner A highly specialized Nurse Practitioner injector with over a decade of experience, Jennifer is an expert within the aesthetics field. Her dream to own her own practice came true in 2010 when she founded Boston Medical Aesthetics. Jennifer holds an esteemed reputation among her broad spectrum of clients as a “natural look injector.” Customizing each client’s treatments with her extensive aesthetic knowledge of the latest products and procedures, Jennifer achieves her client’s goals by enhancing their unique and natural beauty. Drawn from a foundation in nursing, aesthetics, and artistry, Jennifer works with her team of clinicians at Boston Medical Aesthetics to address each patient's unique needs and goals with a customized treatment plan that garners the best possible results. Additional Reading Jennifer is a Board-Certified Adult Nurse Practitioner with expertise in the areas of soft tissue augmentation, neurotoxins and minimally invasive techniques for cosmetic enhancements. She graduated Magna Cum Laude from Boston College and completed her Master of Science in Nursing at MGH Institute of Health Professions. She has achieved expert level certification in the administration of neurotoxins and dermal fillers and is also certified in laser skin rejuvenation and medical grade chemical peels. Jennifer is a member of the Dermatology Nurse Practitioner Society, the American Academy of Nurse Practitioners, the Society of Aesthetic Injectors, and the American Society of Laser Medicine and Surgery. She has over 15 years of experience in the art of facial rejuvenation with cosmetic injectables. She has trained under leaders in the field of aesthetic medicine from Harvard University and Yale University School of Medicine. Her loyal following of clients pays tribute to her ability to subtly rejuvenate the face by restoring volume, smoothing wrinkles, and improving skin quality. Jennifer exemplifies the mission of Boston Medical Aesthetics which is to be a positive force in the lives of patients, treat them with genuine kindness and respect, and help them achieve their aesthetic goals through safe and effective treatments. Deirdre Finn Office Manager Hailing from Cape Cod, Deirdre brings a wealth of experience and a compassionate touch to our team. With over 20 years in the customer service industry, she has a proven track record of creating exceptional experiences for clients. Additional Reading Deirdre’s love for making people feel good shines through in everything she does. As a licensed cosmetologist and skilled hair and makeup artist for six years, she has an innate understanding of beauty and wellness. Her passion for all things beauty—from hair and makeup to skin and nails—ensures that our clients receive the highest level of care and attention. In addition to her impressive professional background, Deirdre is a talented event planner who delights in organizing themed events that create memorable experiences for our staff and patients alike. Her warm demeanor and genuine care for our patients and staff make her a perfect fit for our practice. Amanda Boyd Nurse Practitioner Amanda is a board-certified family nurse practitioner. She graduated summa cum laude from Northeastern University with a Master of Science in Nursing and magna cum laude from Villanova University for her Bachelor of Science in Nursing. Additional Reading Amanda’s clinical expertise includes cardiac ICU working with world renowned cardiovascular and thoracic surgeons at both UCLA Medical Center and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center in Boston. In 2017, Amanda was a recipient of an excellence in nursing practice award, given to less than 2% of clinical nurses at Beth Israel. While studying family medicine for patients across the life span, Amanda became fascinated with the aging process. This sparked her interest in medical aesthetics and ultimately blends her love of art and science. She has had multiple certification courses and has been trained under a Harvard-trained plastic surgeon. Her treatment goals include enhancing natural beauty and empowering clients to feel their best. Kate Deery AGNP-BC Kate Deery, AGNP-BC began her aesthetics journey as a licensed aesthetician in 2010. After nearly a decade of hands-on skincare experience, she pursued her nursing degree and went on to earn her master’s as a nurse practitioner. Kate’s nursing background includes both inpatient care at prestigious hospitals like Spaulding and Beth Israel, as well as outpatient plastic surgery. Over the past five years, she has specialized in cosmetic injectables at top plastic surgery practices in and around Boston. Additional Reading With extensive training, advanced certifications, and a strong clinical foundation, Kate brings a deep understanding of both skin health and aesthetic artistry to every patient interaction. Her knowledge and experience make her a valuable asset to the Boston Medical Aesthetics team, and we’re thrilled to have her on board! When she’s not in the office, Kate enjoys cooking, practicing yoga, and spending time with her family including her two beloved dogs. Erin Walsh Registered Nurse Erin Walsh is a highly skilled registered nurse and aesthetic injector with a strong foundation in both patient care and advanced cosmetic procedures. She earned her BSN from Regis College in 2015, following a BA in English from UMass Amherst in 2004. Erin began her nursing career at leading medical institutions including BI Lahey, Winchester Hospital, and New England Baptist, working primarily in telemetry and med-surg units. Her dedication to excellence was recognized in 2020 when she was nominated for the prestigious Daisy Award at Winchester Hospital. Additional Reading After years of bedside nursing experience, Erin transitioned into aesthetics full-time, bringing her passion for patient care and attention to the cosmetic field. She completed her injectables certification through the American Academy of Facial Esthetics and has since trained extensively with top product lines, including Allergan, RHA, and Merz. Erin has continually advanced her skills through hands-on cadaver labs and ongoing professional education, staying current with the latest techniques in injectables and facial aesthetics. Erin joined Boston Medical Aesthetics in 2023, and quickly became known for the genuine connections she builds with her patients. Her warm, bubbly personality puts everyone at ease, making each visit feel friendly, personal, and comfortable. Erin focuses on neurotoxins and conservative facial balancing, always prioritizing natural, harmonious results. Beyond her clinical work, she has served as an instructor for the National Laser Institute and the Institute of Laser Medicine, and has mentored numerous new injectors through private hands-on training sessions. Outside of her professional life, Erin is devoted to her niece and nephew, Mia and Mackie, and cherishes every moment spent with them. She enjoys skincare, reading, online shopping, and continuing to explore her passion for aesthetics both personally and professionally. Bridget King FNP-C Bridget King, FNP-C is a board-certified Family Nurse Practitioner with a strong foundation in both clinical practice and patient-centered care. She holds a Master of Science in Nursing and a Bachelor of Science in Nursing from Regis College, as well as a Bachelor of Arts in Sociology from Emmanuel College. With a diverse background that includes experience in both pediatric and adult healthcare, Bridget brings a well-rounded and compassionate approach to every patient interaction. Additional Reading Prior to joining the team, Bridget worked as a behavioral health clinician and gained valuable experience in emergency medicine, pediatrics, and chronic care management. Her clinical expertise is matched by her genuine warmth, intelligence, and bubbly personality, which instantly puts patients at ease. Bridget is experienced in a wide range of aesthetic treatments, including chemical peels, HydraFacials, Lumecca IPL, CoolSculpting, and neurotoxin injections. She is passionate about delivering thoughtful, personalized care and helping patients feel confident in their skin. Bridget is thrilled to bring her skills, compassion, and positivity to the world of aesthetics. Maya Crisafulli Licensed Esthetician Maya is an experienced and passionate licensed esthetician, with a strong commitment to improving skin health and empowering her clients to feel confident and beautiful in their own skin. She completed her training at the Elizabeth Grady School of Esthetics in 2020, and since then, she has been working in a medical aesthetics setting, where she has developed a keen understanding of advanced modalities and techniques. Additional Reading Maya specializes in a wide range of aesthetic services and has completed advanced training in multiple technologies and techniques. Her continued education and hands-on experience allow her to deliver consistently high-quality, personalized results for her clients. Danielle Gallo Medical Assistant With over 22 years of dedicated experience in the plastic surgery and aesthetics industry, Danielle Gallo is a vital member of our team at Boston Medical Aesthetics. Her extensive background includes roles at The Breslow Center and Injxcellence Medical Spa, where she honed her clinical and administrative skills, ensuring that patient comfort and safety are always top priorities. Additional Reading Danielle's proficiency in patient preparation, assisting during Botox and filler treatments, and providing comprehensive pre-op and post-op care demonstrates her commitment to excellence. Beyond her technical expertise, Danielle is known for her warmth and compassionate approach. She believes in creating a welcoming atmosphere for every patient, making them feel valued and at ease throughout their aesthetic journey. Her passion for medical aesthetics is evident, and she takes pride in helping others look and feel their best. Outside of work, Danielle is a health and fitness enthusiast who enjoys traveling and spending summers at the beach. Her active lifestyle reflects her dedication to wellness, making her not just a skilled medical assistant but also an inspiring role model for her patients. Mary Alexander Front Desk Coordinator Born and raised in Columbus, OH, Mary graduated from Michigan State University with a degree in Logistics Management. She moved to Boston over four years ago to begin her career in sales and now works as an Account Manager. On Saturdays, we’re lucky to have her at our front desk, where her amazing smile and warm personality brighten everyone’s day. Outside of work, Mary enjoys reading, Pilates classes and exploring new restaurants. Stacy McCarthy Front Desk Coordinator Stacy brings more than a decade of experience in medical aesthetics, plastic surgery, and wellness, with expertise in both patient coordination and medical assisting. Her extensive background in aesthetics has given her a deep understanding of the patient experience and the importance of delivering personalized, attentive service at every touchpoint. She is known for her warm demeanor, professionalism, attention to detail, and ability to ensure every patient feels welcomed, valued, and supported. Additional Reading Originally from Maine, Stacy is happy to call Boston home and enjoys being back in New England. She enjoys building lasting relationships with patients and helping them feel comfortable, welcomed, and cared for from the moment they walk through our doors. Outside of work, Stacy enjoys staying active, spending time with her dog, Luna, and exploring all the great restaurants Boston has to offer. Whether she's trying a new restaurant, enjoying the outdoors, or making memories with friends and family, she values living a balanced lifestyle and embracing new experiences.
